name: Murat Kosshi
location: Aktobe, Kazakhstan · open to relocating to Almaty or Astana
summary:
Backend-leaning full stack developer with 3+ years of commercial experience. I currently work on a production ride-hailing platform: a Laravel backend and Flutter apps for riders and drivers, shipped as several brands from one codebase.

I own tasks end to end: gather requirements with the business, design, build, test on emulators and real devices, and ship to production. I work in a pair with a colleague and we review each other's code.
highlights: We had been building the platform long before the surge; in October 2026, after Yandex Go went down, it got a sudden wave of new riders and drivers. The system held the load; meanwhile I was finding and fixing bottlenecks and bugs directly in production.

Reworked driver location storage: instead of an ever-growing GPS history there is one current position per driver, and history is written only during a ride. Nearest-driver search now runs on the latest-positions table.
Designed and shipped city separation on a "one city = one fleet" model: each fleet sees only its own drivers and orders and manages its city boundary, pricing and staff roles.
Added Comfort and Business service classes and tested the full order flow from fare selection to ride completion.

experience.title: Backend / Mobile Developer
experience.intro: White-label ride-hailing platform: one backend and two Flutter apps (rider and driver) released as OTAN KZ, AllCity, Uly Taxi and Kaspyi Taxi.
items: Keep production stable under growing load: dig through logs and errors, find bottlenecks, optimize queries and background jobs.
Optimized geodata handling: a latest-positions table driver_positions, daily cleanup of old tracks, offline status based on position freshness.
Fleet and city separation: multi-tenancy in the Filament admin, permissions via fleet roles, city boundary on the map, per-city pricing. The main fleet still sees everything.
Comfort and Business fares: backend, app UI, testing.
Improved order dispatch: sequential offers to the nearest driver. Fixed cases where driver search stopped early.
Test releases on Android and iOS emulators and real devices. Wrote ride simulation scripts: driver and rider in separate emulators, moving along real roads via Valhalla.
Work directly with the business and fleet managers: collect requirements, estimate, ship features fast, help during incidents.
Review merge requests, write tests, track tech debt.
